evidence.advisor_audit: measured this release against the live chat and worker paths. All 3 Jev gates pass in a real browser: the badge renders pass-shaped, the inconclusive verdict renders a NEUTRAL badge with the request firing (calls:1), and the badge survives the Simple-mode toggle with no refetch. The advisor button opens the chat modal and sends the brief. On the worker path, invalid kWh and malformed share coordinates are rejected before a worker starts. The provider is stubbed.
notes: the local browser smoke is 147/147 with zero failures. The earlier 146/147 was the Jev badge gate on calls:0 and two runs aborted on 'DevTools endpoint never came up'; all three were transient

FIXED. chat.js's grid-equivalence block was DEAD: #gridEqBox/#gridEqText exist in no page, so its own guard returned early and its 'before adding panels ... a real off-grid budget' copy could never reach a visitor - verified in a browser, then deleted rather than localized. The LIVE defect was the advisor brief: buildIntakeBrief had no mode signal, so a battery-only visitor could be answered with panels it does not have. It now reads #hardwareConfig/#systemGoal; the POST body is unchanged, so no server contract moved

the pre-promote probe proved the bug this release fixed: production served stamp 20260925a, which MATCHED the checkout, while 350 of 358 files differed and the smoke failed five gates. bump-asset-tokens --check passes on that tree, so the stamp is now bumped
